reason: The carousel stage must be tall enough for its 3:4 cards, whose width is the stage's own --card-w clamp(230px,24vw,320px); the height follows that width, so no spacing token or fixed scale value fits.
The check mark is an inline glyph that must scale with whatever text it sits in (it stands in for a ✓ Figtree lacks); the spacing scale is rem-based, not em.
The lightbox stage is sized against the viewport height, which no token or spacing step expresses.
Photos and videos in the lightbox are capped to a share of the viewport height so the caption and controls stay on screen.
The dialog is capped to a share of the viewport height so it scrolls inside instead of overflowing the screen.
